prompt: An emblem for the back of every card in Thoth's deck: a scribe's palette of gold, upright, with two ink wells (red and black) and a reed pen, crossed by a was-sceptre, with a small moon disc above, inlaid in lapis and turquoise. Rustic 1990s hand-painted style, symmetrical and centred on a fully transparent background. No letters, no hieroglyphs, no badge behind it.
